presets.label: Quadruped · 5 mm lift trial
presets.description: A 16 mm body shift followed by a requested 5 mm foot lift. Recorded motor-driven execution, not an animation of the target.
presets.readiness: Experiment · sampled lift check passes; no internal contacts reported after collision-grid correction.
presets.evidence: The foot clears 1 mm while the three support feet carry at least 1 N for 120 ms. Peak clearance is about 1.68 mm. Both tested timesteps agree on that outcome. Landing, slip and hardware accuracy are not accepted yet.

presets.label: Quadruped · 3 mm lift attempt
presets.description: The earlier 3 mm request transferred weight but left the selected foot touching the floor.
presets.readiness: Failed lift · retained for comparison.
presets.evidence: The robot completes the requested motor program, but the foot never clears the sampled floor. This shows why a completed simulation is not automatically a successful task.

presets.label: Quadruped · live lift experiment
presets.description: Execute the motor-driven lift through the same incremental Rust session as the headless experiment. Physics runs in a background worker.
presets.readiness: Live experiment · native/browser trajectory check passes; about 60× slower than realtime on the tested CPU.
presets.evidence: All 161 sampled frames pass the native/browser comparison and browser replay is exact. The recipe passes a sampled lift check. Landing, walking, sensor realism and hardware accuracy remain unaccepted.

presets.label: Quadruped · 10 mm placement attempt
presets.description: Move the -Y foot 10 mm in world +X, lower it, qualify support, then return the body shift. The foot remains at its new requested location.
presets.readiness: Fails supported-lift check · 0.25 ms run sustains the required conditions for 40 ms; 50 ms required.
presets.evidence: The foot reaches a new location, but its supported swing is too short under the existing lift requirement. This failed stepping candidate is preserved for inspection; it is not an accepted walking controller.

presets.label: Quadruped · slower 10 mm placement
presets.description: The same 10 mm foot placement stretched to 1.5 times its original duration. Motor gains, controller clocks, physics parameters and support thresholds stay unchanged.
presets.readiness: Experimental · supported lift passes; internal hip contact and timestep sensitivity remain unresolved.
presets.evidence: The 0.25 and 0.125 ms runs sustain qualifying lift for 270 and 180 ms, above the unchanged 50 ms requirement. Their foot paths differ by up to 1.73 mm and both report a brief internal hip contact. This is not an accepted landing or walking controller.

presets.label: Quadruped · placement with corrected collision signs
presets.description: The slower 10 mm placement with chassis collision signs derived from separate CAD solids. The motor program and physical parameters are unchanged.
presets.readiness: Experimental · sampled lift passes and false hip contact is removed; placement and walking remain unvalidated.
presets.evidence: Both tested timesteps finish without reported internal contacts. Supported lift lasts 270 / 180 ms, but foot trajectories still differ by up to 1.73 mm. The corrected signs change foot motion by at most 0.00612 mm, so tracking and balance remain separate problems.

presets.label: Quadruped · body position feedback
presets.description: Use ideal body position and floor loads to suggest small joint corrections through the shared mechanism Jacobian. The original joint feedback and servo physics remain active.
presets.readiness: Experimental · both timesteps pass sampled lift; body and final foot errors improve, but trajectory sensitivity remains.
presets.evidence: With body gain 0.25, final foot XY error is 0.78 / 0.67 mm and supported lift lasts 170 ms at both tested timesteps. Peak body shift undershoot is about 1.55 mm. The foot paths still differ by up to 2.06 mm, so this is not accepted walking or hardware accuracy. Inspect body targets, support weights and bounded corrections below.

presets.label: Quadruped · swing foot position feedback
presets.description: Correct ideal world foot-position error during the planned swing through bounded motor-target suggestions. Shared Rust linkage geometry, body/joint feedback and servo physics remain active.
presets.readiness: Experimental tradeoff · higher clearance and smaller peak swing error, but worse landing placement; not accepted walking.
presets.evidence: Both timesteps pass sampled supported lift for 200 / 210 ms. Peak foot-path error falls to 3.76 / 3.75 mm, but final horizontal error grows to 1.03 / 1.25 mm and timestep foot-path differences reach 2.18 mm. The correction is active only during planned swing; inspect its activation and target/actual readouts below.

presets.label: Quadruped · swing feedback with final correction
presets.description: The same swing-foot controller, with a solver experiment that uses fresh final corrections before requesting a smaller physics step.
presets.readiness: Numerical checks pass · both native timesteps, browser parity and replay verified. Experimental controller; not realtime or accepted walking.
presets.evidence: Fresh final corrections remove the refined 0.041 A current discrepancy without changing tolerances. Maximum refined current difference is below 1e-9 A. Both timesteps pass strict numerical comparisons and sampled supported lift; all 281 browser frames, replay/reset and 20 UI checks pass. Existing landing and calibration limits remain.

presets.label: Quadruped · swing feedback with sample reuse
presets.description: The same swing-foot controller with guarded Jacobian reuse across registered servo sampling events. Motor-mode changes still discard the matrix; physical equations and command limits stay active.
presets.readiness: Unpromoted optimization · browser checks pass; refined motor-state comparison exceeds strict limits.
presets.evidence: A native pair took 160 s with ordinary reuse versus 116 s with reuse across servo samples (2.8 simulated seconds). At 0.25 ms, motion and current agree at roundoff scale; at 0.125 ms, current differs by 0.041 A after a subdivision difference despite only 44 nm of foot motion difference. All 281 native/WASM samples and replay/reset pass. Not realtime or accepted walking.

presets.label: Quadruped · swing feedback with block solver
presets.description: The same swing-foot controller with exact independent-block linkage factorization. Robot properties, controller gains, reference motion and rank thresholds are unchanged.
presets.readiness: Unpromoted numerical experiment · refined-state and strict native/WASM comparisons fail; original solver remains default.
presets.evidence: A native pair took 159 s with the original factorization versus 152 s with blocks. Refined motor current differs by up to 0.041 A despite only 44 nm of foot-position difference. One browser force reading also exceeds the strict 1e-7 N parity limit. Execution/replay and sampled lift work, but this is not an accepted optimization or realtime result.

presets.description: After the planned foot descent, body-return motion waits for sustained support on all four feet. Physics and joint feedback keep running during the wait.
presets.readiness: Experimental support checkpoint · ideal force observations; landing placement and balance are not accepted.
presets.evidence: A shared Rust motion clock requires at least 1 N on each foot for 100 ms during the guarded return. It stops the experiment if support does not qualify within the 300 ms pause budget.
presets.label: Quadruped · support-qualified return

presets.description: Joint feedback with named body and foot observations. Inspect relative foot motion, body orientation and floor forces before developing landing and balance control.
presets.readiness: Ideal state diagnostics · controller still uses joint feedback; hardware sensor mapping remains open.
presets.evidence: This preset exposes signals needed for task-space control. It does not yet use them to control landing or balance.
presets.label: Quadruped · body and foot observations

presets.description: A Rhai controller compares planned and actual joint angles, then adjusts the motor targets. Gain 0 follows the sampled plan; higher gain adds tracking correction.
presets.readiness: Feedback experiment · ideal joint observations; hardware sensing, landing and walking remain unvalidated.
presets.evidence: Gain 0.5 reduces worst sampled body-relative foot error from 4.77 mm to 3.14 mm and increases peak clearance to 2.69 mm. The lift check passes at both tested timesteps; all 161 browser frames pass native comparison. Landing, balance, backlash convergence and hardware accuracy remain unaccepted.
presets.label: Quadruped · joint feedback 0.5

presets.description: A Rhai controller compares planned and actual joint angles, then adjusts the motor targets. Gain 0 follows the sampled plan; higher gain adds tracking correction.
presets.readiness: Feedback experiment · ideal joint observations; hardware sensing, landing and walking remain unvalidated.
presets.evidence: Native 1.6 s comparison: gain 0.5 reduces the worst sampled body-relative foot tracking error from 4.77 mm to 3.14 mm. This does not certify world foothold accuracy or balance.
presets.label: Quadruped · joint feedback 0
Motorized pendulum · embedded servo
presets.description: A short registered-servo experiment using the incremental mechanism and motor runtime.
presets.readiness: Live runtime fixture · fixed target, 20 ms diagnostic.
presets.evidence: Used to check host chunking, firmware state and replay before full-robot browser delivery. No walking command is declared.

presets.label: Motorized pendulum · local motor solve
presets.description: The detailed motor equations are solved inside each mechanical trial. Independent motor derivatives share probes, and convergence checks measure corrections in physical state units. Inspect the shared Rust and WASM runtime.
presets.readiness: Solver experiment · short validation fixture; full-robot performance is not established.
presets.evidence: Independent circuit and coupled-state tests verify the unchanged equations; structural audits check when derivative probes may be combined. This preset checks browser execution and replay; it is not an accepted training model or walking controller.

presets.label: Motorized pendulum · sampled Rhai
presets.description: Adjust the command while Rhai controls the shared incremental motor simulation. Input changes are recorded in simulation time.
presets.readiness: Controller experiment · ideal simulator observations, not calibrated hardware sensors.
presets.evidence: Named angular observations and bounded targets use the shared Rust controller contract. This fixture checks scheduling and input replay; it is not a walking policy.

presets.label: Motorized pendulum · live control
presets.description: A live CAD-derived mechanism driven by the shared Rust runtime and Rhai controller. Change its position target while it runs.
presets.readiness: Live WASM fixture · quadruped motor-runtime integration remains in progress.
presets.evidence: This fixture exercises live worker execution, controller inputs, reset and deterministic input replay. Its performance does not establish full-robot performance.

presets.label: Quadruped · direct linkage positions
presets.description: The swing-foot controller with direct knee and transmission position calculations. All moving parts, actuator physics and original linkage checks are retained.
presets.readiness: Solver experiment · initial stepping, not accepted walking or realtime.
presets.evidence: Both native timestep runs preserve the previous motion to numerical precision and pass the sampled supported-lift check. Hardware calibration, landing accuracy and training-model acceptance remain open.

presets.label: Quadruped · explicit drive definition
presets.description: Live Rust controller with explicitly idealized drive connections and a 1 ms nominal timestep. Motor electrical and firmware dynamics remain active.
presets.readiness: Experiment · drive-connection backlash estimated as zero; hardware calibration pending.
presets.evidence: All 12 drive connections have explicit provenance, separate from bearing clearance. Full native runs at 1 and 0.125 ms differ by at most 0.120 mm in sampled foot positions and pass 360 ms of supported lift. Electrical transients remain timestep sensitive. This is not accepted walking or hardware accuracy.

presets.label: Motor fixture · explicit drive backlash
presets.description: Synthetic v4 drive-backlash definition through the shared Rust runtime.
presets.readiness: Fixture · explicit provenance; no hardware calibration.
presets.evidence: Drive connection and motor gearbox gaps are combined explicitly. Unknown drive values are rejected.

presets.label: Quadruped · teacher environment
presets.description: Live 50 Hz task transitions over the same Rust motor and mechanism simulation. Adjust controller gains, inspect the score, and replay the held commands.
presets.readiness: Teacher interface · ideal observations and provisional tracking reward; no trained walking policy.
presets.evidence: The task exposes 54 named quantities with SI units. Commands go through the existing Rhai controller and servo physics. Drive-connection backlash remains explicitly estimated as zero. Endpoint joint tracking alone does not establish stepping success or hardware readiness.

presets.label: Pendulum · teacher environment
presets.description: A small held-action training-interface fixture with the same Rust environment as the quadruped.
presets.readiness: Synthetic interface fixture, not a trained policy.
presets.evidence: Exercises endpoint observations, task scores, bounded actions, reset and replay.
